purpose: Explain five-row context gains and rare-class failure before proposing a new methodology; no model fitting or official test.
input_policy: Original official TRAINING CSV only plus frozen SCV split and private E2/E3 INTERNAL validation checkpoint/predictions. Never open official test or official test predictions.

source_order_audit.independent_baseline: expected_same_label_adjacent = sum of squared within-partition class proportions

diagnostic_model: Read-only E3 LightGBM stats_rare_sqrt (seed42). Internal validation was used for early stopping; output is an exploratory diagnostic, not an unbiased test.

counterfactual.intervention: Permute one historical full 42-feature record in internal validation windows, preserve newest row and labels, recompute all dependent numeric summaries; run the *same untouched E3 fitted booster*, not retraining.
counterfactual.note: These are out-of-distribution perturbations of test-like internal validation, not causal treatment effects or verified temporal evidence.

publish_policy: Only aggregated counts, metrics, confusion, importances, metadata. Never export row-level features, IDs, class probabilities, fitted booster or model weights publicly.
gating: No new architecture or original official-test retesting. Report diagnostics even if effects are artifacts.
